headline: Lincoln host the last side to hold them
dek: Since Indianapolis drew with them in October, Lincoln have won six matches in a row and are thirteen wins and four draws into a season without defeat. All four draws came away from home; Drury and Maryville, level in second, have both lost to them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist have scored forty-five goals, more than either Lincoln or Drury near the top, but they have conceded thirty-six and lost seven times; the leaders have built their place at the other end of the pitch.

wire.line: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference still without a defeat this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Drury have lost four times this season: at home to Oklahoma Christian in August, away at Missouri S&T in September, and at home to Lincoln and to Missouri-St. Louis in October.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jonathan Nemorden, a freshman, has twelve of Lincoln's thirty-seven goals, from sixty shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Panagos, a midfielder, has fourteen of Truman's twenty-six goals, from fifty shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made seventy-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty-five, a save percentage of .693.

last_match.line: Quincy end the conference schedule on a losing run that began at Lincoln; Indianapolis have not lost at home since Maryville beat them in September.

next_match.line: Lincoln have won every match they have played at home; Indianapolis have won their last two.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
